sentences.en: Departmental disagreements led the corporation to split into five separate companies.
sentences.zh: 部门间的分歧导致这家企业分裂成了五家独立的公司。

sentences.en: This study grant was given to me by the departmental council.
sentences.zh: 这项研究资助是由部门理事会给予我的。

sentences.en: I missed the departmental meeting because I was sick.
sentences.zh: 因为我生病了，所以错过了部门会议。

senses.zh: 部门的，各部的,各县的,分科的
